name: set_calendar_event_allow_task_projections
description:
Turn task projection on or off for one calendar event the user identified.

WRITE — CONFIRM FIRST. This modifies a setting on a real calendar event. Name the event back to the user and confirm the direction of the change before calling; the event ID is opaque, so a wrong ID silently changes the wrong meeting. Do not toggle this to make another operation succeed, and do not change it across multiple events without approval for each.

eventId.description: The ID of the calendar event

allowTasksProjectedAtSameTime.description: Whether to allow tasks during this event
